independence: Distinct from the source implementer and accepting lead; no source/governance edits or subdelegation. Sole owned output is this review.

criteria.evidence: Actual service projects each original tracked record ID without changing the decision/record pair. SDK source and both shipped bundles preserve explicit attrs, binding-time IDs in both declarative branches, and the fourth rendered argument through impression/dwell; legacy and no-tracking paths remain. Mounted two-host checks reject malformed present references before host effects and preserve valid/absent outcome identity. Exact frozen selection passed.

Shared attribution selects exactly one owned tenant/visitor/brand receipt and retains existing time/session/item/product/named-slot restrictions. Duplicates are considered before arm/brand filtering; absent-ID behavior is preserved. Actual local ring/statistics fixtures refuse ambiguity/holdout credit, retain exposure counts and repeated credits. Raw/hourly fixtures agree, including foreign-subject duplicate preceding the target: explicit raw arm lookup is subject-scoped, legacy first-match remains.

New reports use computation basis2; homogeneous retained basis1 stays basis1 without mutation, and mixed hour/window bases refuse pooling. All 29 selected tests, fresh installed esbuild write:false parity, final worker compiler/lint/whitespace reuse and independent 164-pin/22-delta reconciliation pass. This is bounded local correlation containment, not full W26 or measurement acceptance.

basis.instructions: Personally read applicable entry/governance/checkpoint, complete W26 and linked findings, current complete plan-v3 and criteria. Reused unchanged personally inspected dependencies and lead entry-board assurance; no duplicate board run.
